changelog:
- New brute-force detector: alerts when a single IP accumulates too many failed logins in a sliding time window (threshold and window configurable)
- New Reason column showing why a connection was flagged, also included in the CSV export
- Risk fix: high-port heuristic now uses the remote port instead of the local one
- Lighter scans: one system command per scan and capped concurrent command threads
- More reliable listener detection: stale binary fingerprints are now pruned
- CSV export now escapes commas/quotes correctly
- Cleaner settings (removed a dead firewall-scan option) and unified IP/CIDR handling across modules
- Clearer privacy wording: local analysis, with only opt-in outbound calls (version check, signed feed, on-demand IP geolocation)
